workload: Same3 documents P32/P32/P128, outputs16/16/8; inject new request after4 old outputs; release chunk8 only after both old requests complete
reset: Existing drained metadata reset, common warmups, allocations and KV free queue preserved; all runtime layer records retained across episodes
question: Does retaining completed layer traces and CUDA-event references cause avoidable GC/host cost when all logging/reclamation costs are included?
basis: Previous identical none/early release8 A/A observed mixed-call spikes overlapping gen2 GC; 1600 to15648 live retained layer records; prior sustained drift not explained.
action: Only change trace lifecycle: memory retains until finalize; episode settles CUDA events, appends all completed records and releases their references at each drained episode boundary. No manual GC or threshold changes.
baseline: Both modes use same refactored recorder and finalize path, none/early/release8, same3 documents/common warmups/resources; only flush placement differs.

accounting.primary: Parent process wall includes engine initialization, all warmups, measured requests, IO, flush/sync/decref, finalization, GC observation export and interpreter exit.
accounting.secondary: Post-init cycle starts before first reset and ends after shutdown; includes all per-episode bookkeeping and final trace writes; excludes its own final marker write, covered by parent wall.
accounting.descriptive: Capture wall, all old/new TTFT/maxITL/completion, GC overlaps by capture/warmup/flush/cycle, RSS and live records/events. Never subtract GC as a counterfactual speedup.

integrity: Every call_id unique and consecutive across flushes; no lost/duplicated records or summaries, source/request/row/action trajectory and resource equality checked; original raw/failures preserved.
interpretation: A shorter capture window alone may be cost movement. Only jointly inspect process/cycle cost and per-request delay; this is measurement infrastructure diagnosis, no scheduler novelty or method GO.
variance: Two fresh engines per mode, eight dependent episodes per engine; ABBA mitigates first-order order drift only. Report all runs and both pairings; no significance or population noise bound.
stop: Other GPU process/query error or runtime/trace loss abort, retain failure; no automatic retry. No new models/resources or policy tuning.
claim_ceiling: Single-model/artificial-cap native eager measurement-tool lifecycle intervention; no prior drift root-cause closure unless observed, no task quality/production/general speedup claim.
next: If trace retention tax is reduced with complete cost and unchanged workload, retain the cheaper measurement path and return to same-budget mechanism residual; otherwise keep baseline and narrow remaining overhead.
cpu_checks: 3 targeted trace flush tests passed (stream vs final records/statistics, IDs, partial-write failstop); 10 existing expert-group tests passed; syntax/diff checks passed
